responsibility: This definition module declares miscellaneous C wrapper functions that are inconvenient to model directly as builtins or raw libc interfaces. It belongs to the gm2 low-level C interop layer and exports helpers for textual time, file metadata, random numbers, username and uid/gid lookup, and callable wrappers for signbit and isfinite variants, providing support routines used by higher-level modules such as TimeString and Builtins when direct compiler intrinsics or libc declarations are insufficient.
